_note: Mechanical damage sounds (audio/crash.js mechanical, made as it plays: no files). hiss: a boost leak — noise through a band-pass from hz[0] to hz[1] as the boost rises, as loud as the share leaking × the boost now (× gain). steam: steam from the engine bay (a leaking radiator, an overheating engine: the effects' steam) — noise band-passed round hz, as loud as the steam (× gain). flap: a soft or flat tyre slapping once a turn — a thump at hz lasting seconds, by how soft (× gain). grind: a damaged gearbox taking (or missing) a gear — gear teeth at hz buzzing through noise for seconds, by the damage (× gain). whine: a damaged diff — a tone at hzPerRev × the drive shaft's turns a second, rising with speed from fromSpeed m/s (× gain × damage). exhaust: a holed exhaust — the engine's own sound clipped (drive), band-passed round hz and rattled (rattleHz: how fast its level jumps about), mixed back in at gain × the damage; torn off it's all holes.
